name: text-drop-bounce
title: Drop & Bounce In
description: Từng chữ cái rơi từ trên cao xuống, chạm sàn rồi nảy thấp dần ba lần trước khi nằm yên, có bóng đổ dưới sàn theo độ cao.

moworks.author: takayu

options.shadow: a floor shadow under each letter
options.drop: px it sinks on the exit (120)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-drop-bounce-in, written here): Per char: y −200 px → 0, bounce.out 0.9 s, stagger 0.04 s (capped so all start within 1.2 s), from 0.3 s; 3 shrinking rebounds. Optional floor shadow under each char: ellipse 0.9 × char width, scaleY 0.18, scaleX max(0.2, 1 − h / 200), opacity 0.28 × (1 − h / 160), h = height above the floor. Exit 3.15–3.45 s: opacity 1 → 0 and y +30 px, power2.in. First char accent. Loop 3.6 s. Params: độ cao rơi (200 px) · thời gian (0.9 s) · cách nhau (0.04 s) · bóng sàn (bật / tắt).
moworks.titleVi: Từng chữ rơi xuống nảy trên sàn
